In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] launched a '''mission''' to rescue [[Nat Secura]], who had been [[Mission to Ryloth (Jedi Order)|captured]] by [[Morgukai]] agents of [[Kh'aris Fenn]] and was being held on the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]].
